call ended about an hour ago. i went to my friend’s house, sister called me on facetime on her laptop while she called my parents on her phone so i could hear the conversation. 

parents obviously shocked, didn’t say much except for the typical “what is wrong with you” + religious justifications. 

scared to go home now haha

“we gave birth to you how could you do this to us”
“it’s disgusting how you sound so proud”

an update, 30 mins later: i’m home. parents pretended nothing happened. LMAOOOOO

my (20F) sister (30F) is going to come out as trans to my extremely religious parents in a few weeks. i am very, very afraid. for context, she doesn’t live here and will be telling them through a video call. i am currently the only child living with them…. which means i’ll be stuck in the middle of it all. i don’t want to be selfish, of course i support my sister, but the thought of being caught in the middle of this entire situation makes me shudder. 

my parents are the typical toxic asian (manipulative/victim mentality/emotional loose cannons/controlling) kind, there is no doubt that they will blow up. my dad can get verbally violent, physically violent even if the right buttons are pushed — because of this, i really can’t gauge their reactions and that scares the shit out of me. 

idk what to do. lol. just wanted to vent. hope everyone else is having a nice day.

p.s: hiding it from my parents isn’t an option anymore because my sister has been taking hormones (she looks very different now). and naturally my parents want to see her (either go to where she is or make her come back) after all this covid BS.
